## Type

- [ ] `fix` — corrects an inaccurate claim
- [ ] `feat` — new reference, script, or check
- [ ] `docs` — wording, structure, translation

## Checklist

- [ ] `bash scripts/self-test.sh` passes locally
- [ ] Any changed factual claim links to official Next.js or Google documentation (or includes command output)
- [ ] If a reference was added, it is registered in `references/00-index.md`
- [ ] `SKILL.md` is still under the body size limit (self-test enforces this)
- [ ] No new dependencies
- [ ] If a script changed, a functional test was added or updated in `scripts/self-test.sh`
- [ ] If behaviour changed, `CHANGELOG.md` was updated under `[Unreleased]`
